thesis: Mohnish Pabrai argues that success is not a single act but requires repeatedly doing what you want to achieve, noting that failure is essential because it makes a person better and stronger for future success. He illustrates this point by explaining that while many people from top institutions like IITs work for companies like Google, the specific educational background or effort of the individual is not the sole determinant of success.
